SELECT ARRAY[st.workspace_id::text,st.source_kind::text,st.session_id::text,st.turn_idx::text] AS key,st.text_embedding::text AS embedding,st.text_embedding_profile AS embedding_profile,st.text_embedding_mode AS embedding_mode FROM harness_shared.session_turns st WHERE (
          
          (st.workspace_id = $1 OR st.workspace_id = 'default')
      AND ($2::text IS NULL OR st.harness_slug = $3)
      AND ($4::text[] IS NULL OR st.owner = ANY($5::text[]))
      AND ($6::text IS NULL OR st.speaker = $7)
      AND ($8::text IS NULL OR st.turn_origin_verdict = $9)
      AND ($10::boolean IS NULL OR NOT $11 OR st.turn_origin_verdict IN ('owner-typed', 'owner-dialog'))
      AND ($12::boolean IS NULL OR NOT $13 OR st.turn_origin_verdict = ANY($14::text[]))
      AND ($15::text IS NULL OR st.session_id = $16)
      AND ($17::text IS NULL OR st.source_kind = $18)
      AND ($19::timestamptz IS NULL OR COALESCE(st.ts, st.ingested_at) >= $20::timestamptz)
      AND ($21::timestamptz IS NULL OR COALESCE(st.ts, st.ingested_at) < $22::timestamptz)
      AND NOT (
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM harness_shared.personal_disclosures d
             WHERE d.agent_owner_id = "st".owner
               AND d.agent_owner_id <> ALL($23::text[])
               AND d.delivered_at <= COALESCE("st".ts, "st".ingested_at)
               AND (d.released_at IS NULL OR COALESCE("st".ts, "st".ingested_at) < d.released_at))
    OR (("st".owner IS NULL OR btrim("st".owner) = '')
        AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM harness_shared.personal_disclosures d
                     WHERE d.agent_owner_id <> ALL($24::text[])
                       AND d.delivered_at <= COALESCE("st".ts, "st".ingested_at)
                       AND (d.released_at IS NULL OR COALESCE("st".ts, "st".ingested_at) < d.released_at)))
  ))
        AND st.text_embedding IS NOT NULL
        AND ((st.text_embedding_profile = $25 OR (st.text_embedding_profile IS NULL AND st.text_embedding_mode = $26)))
    ORDER BY ARRAY[st.workspace_id::text,st.source_kind::text,st.session_id::text,st.turn_idx::text] LIMIT 4096
